description_en: Deletes complete videos, including video source files, transcoded stream files, and thumbnails
description_zh: 删除完整视频（包括视频源文件、转码后的流文件、封面截图等）
name: DeleteVideo

parameters.help_en:
The list of video IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 20 IDs are supported. You can obtain video IDs by using the following methods:
For videos uploaded through the console, log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Media Files > Audio/Video to view the video ID.
When you upload a video by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html operation, the video ID is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.
After a video is uploaded, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html operation to query the video ID, which is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response
parameters.help_zh:
视频ID列表。由一个或多个视频ID组成，多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多支持20个。视频ID可通过以下方式获取：
通过控制台上传的视频，可登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看视频ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html接口上传视频时，视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
视频上传后，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html接口查询视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值

The list of video IDs that do not exist.
If some of the video IDs in the request do not exist, those non-existent video IDs are returned. If all video IDs in the request do not exist, a 404 error is returned
